decisive_items: One year earlier, the patient had visited an East-Turkish region
response.rationale: Culture-proven B. melitensis is pathognomonic for brucellosis; the subcutaneous collection along the VP shunt is a local manifestation of the infection, not a primary shunt infection or breast abscess.

rejected.why: Lesion is between neck and breast, not breast tissue; no breast-specific findings.
Culture grew B. melitensis, not typical shunt pathogens; imaging shows tracking along shunt but etiology is brucellar.
